```{r}
#FUNCTIONS FOR TREE ALLOMETRY 
#Above DBH trees used in Alexander et al. 2012, equations from Yarie et al. 2007, function based on species and DBH (cm) measurement; output in g/tree
allom.dbh <- function(x, y) {
  treebiomass <- numeric(length(x)) 
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    if (x[i] == "BETNEO") {
      a <- 164.18
      b <- 2.29
    } else if (x[i] == "PICGLA") {
      a <- 96.77
      b <- 2.40
      # Making PICEA use the PICGLA allometry equations b/c PICEA is only at one site and no PICMAR recorded there, only PICMAR
    } else if (x[i] == "PICEA") {
      a <- 96.77
      b <- 2.40
    } else if (x[i] == "PICMAR") {
      a <- 271.46
      b <- 1.84
    } else if (x[i] == "POPTRE") {
      a <- 134.10
      b <- 2.26
    } else if (x[i] == "POPBAL") {
      a <- 133.71
      b <- 2.29
    } else if (x[i] == "LARLAR") {
      a <- 10^2.648
      b <- 0.715
    } else {
      a <- NA
      b <- NA
    }
    treebiomass[i] <- a * ((y[i])^b)
  }
  return(treebiomass) 
}


# decid vs. conifer set up
decid <- c("POPTRE", "BETNEO", "POPBAL")

# live trees
tree.summary.species <- trees.2 %>%
  mutate(above_dbh_biomass = allom.dbh(SPECIES, DBH)) %>%
  left_join(ages) %>%
  mutate(func_gp = ifelse(SPECIES %in% decid, "Decid_Broad", "Conifer")) %>%
  filter(DA!=0) %>%
  mutate(area.sampled = Plot.Area.M2 * sampled_plots_period, 
         BA = 0.00007854 * (DBH)^2) %>%
  group_by(func_gp,Year, PLOT, area.sampled) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), mean_dbh = mean(DBH, na.rm = T), se_dbh = sd(DBH, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n()), 
            ba = sum(BA, na.rm = T), mean_above_bio = sum(above_dbh_biomass, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(dens = n/area.sampled, ba_m2 = ba/area.sampled, agb_m2 = mean_above_bio/area.sampled) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Year, PLOT, area.sampled),
              names_from = func_gp,
              values_from = c(dens, mean_dbh, se_dbh, ba_m2, agb_m2),
              names_glue = "{func_gp}_{.value}") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with(c("_dens", "_ba_m2", "mean_dbh", "se_dbh", "agb_m2")), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

tree.summary <- trees.2 %>%
  mutate(above_dbh_biomass = allom.dbh(SPECIES, DBH)) %>%
  left_join(ages) %>%
  mutate(func_gp = ifelse(SPECIES %in% decid, "Decid_Broad", "Conifer")) %>%
  filter(DA!=0) %>%
  mutate(area.sampled = Plot.Area.M2 * sampled_plots_period, 
         BA = 0.00007854 * (DBH)^2) %>%
  group_by(Year, PLOT, area.sampled) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), mean_dbh = mean(DBH, na.rm = T), se_dbh = sd(DBH, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n()), 
            ba = sum(BA, na.rm = T), mean_above_bio = sum(above_dbh_biomass, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(dens = n/area.sampled, ba_m2 = ba/area.sampled, agb_m2 = mean_above_bio/area.sampled) %>%
  select(-c(n, ba, mean_above_bio))

tree.sum <- left_join(tree.summary, tree.summary.species)

# Recruitment  
recruit <- trees.2%>%
  mutate(above_dbh_biomass = allom.dbh(SPECIES, DBH)) %>%
  left_join(ages) %>%
  mutate(func_gp = ifelse(SPECIES %in% decid, "Decid_Broad", "Conifer")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DBH) & DA == 1) %>%
  group_by(UniqueID) %>%
  arrange(sample.pd, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # sample area
   area.sampled = Plot.Area.M2 * sampled_plots_period, 
    lag_DBH = lag(DBH),
    # BA in m2
        # BA in m2
    BA = 0.00007854 * (DBH)^2,
    BA_diff = BA - lag(BA),
    Year_diff = Year - lag(Year),
    Annual_Growth = (DBH - lag_DBH) / Year_diff,
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # filter to just look at smaple round 3 that have an NA growth rate from period one
  filter(is.na(Annual_Growth)) %>%
  filter(sample.pd != 1) %>%
  # # filter FP5A for now because not qutie right and FP5D
  # filter(site_yr %!in% c("FP5D_8", "FP5A_8")) %>%
  # filter out species that are way too big!
  filter(DBH < 8) %>%
  #left_join(dbh.25) %>%
  #mutate(biomass_above = above_dbh_biomass - biomass) %>%
  group_by(PLOT, Year, func_gp, area.sampled) %>%
  summarize(
   mean_dbh_rec = mean(DBH, na.rm= T),se_dbh_rec = sd(DBH, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n()), agb = sum(above_dbh_biomass),
   ba_rec = sum(BA), 
   n_trees_rec = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(dens_m2_rec = n_trees_rec/area.sampled, ba_m2_rec = ba_rec/area.sampled, agb_m2_rec = agb/area.sampled) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Year, PLOT, area.sampled),
              names_from = func_gp,
              values_from = c(n_trees_rec, dens_m2_rec, mean_dbh_rec, se_dbh_rec, ba_m2_rec, agb_m2_rec),
              names_glue = "{func_gp}_{.value}") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with(c("dens_m2_rec", "mean_dbh_rec", "se_dbh_rec", "ba_m2_rec","agb_m2_rec")), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tot_dens_rec = Conifer_dens_m2_rec + Decid_Broad_dens_m2_rec, tot_ba_rec = Conifer_ba_m2_rec + Decid_Broad_ba_m2_rec, tot_agb_rec = Conifer_agb_m2_rec + Decid_Broad_agb_m2_rec)

# Death
death.trees <- trees.2 %>%
  left_join(ages) %>%
  filter(DA == 0 & sample.pd != 1)%>%
  select(UniqueID, SPECIES)%>%
  distinct() 

death <- trees.2%>%
  mutate(above_dbh_biomass = allom.dbh(SPECIES, DBH)) %>%
  left_join(ages)%>%
  mutate(func_gp = ifelse(SPECIES %in% decid, "Decid_Broad", "Conifer")) %>%
  filter(UniqueID %in% death.trees$UniqueID) %>%
  filter(DA == 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DBH)) %>%
  group_by(UniqueID) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = sample.pd, n = 1)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(
    # sample area
    area.sampled = Plot.Area.M2 * sampled_plots_period, 
    BA = 0.00007854 * (DBH)^2,
    Year_diff = Year - lag(Year)
  ) %>%
  # filter FP5A for now because not qutie right and FP5D
  #filter(site_yr %!in% c("FP5D_8", "FP5A_8")) %>%
  group_by(PLOT, Year, func_gp, area.sampled) %>%
  summarize(
   mean_dbh_death = mean(DBH, na.rm= T),se_dbh_death = sd(DBH, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n()), agb = sum(above_dbh_biomass),
   ba_death = sum(BA), 
   n_trees_death = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(dens_m2_death = n_trees_death/area.sampled, ba_death_m2 = ba_death/area.sampled, agb_death_m2 = agb/area.sampled) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Year, PLOT, area.sampled),
              names_from = func_gp,
              values_from = c(n_trees_death, dens_m2_death, mean_dbh_death, se_dbh_death, ba_death_m2,agb_death_m2),
              names_glue = "{func_gp}_{.value}") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with(c("n_trees_death", "dens_m2_death", "mean_dbh_death", "se_dbh_death", "ba_death_m2","agb_death_m2")), ~replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  mutate(tot_death_trees = Decid_Broad_n_trees_death + Conifer_n_trees_death, tot_dens_m2_death = Decid_Broad_dens_m2_death + Conifer_dens_m2_death, tot_ba_m2_death = Decid_Broad_ba_death_m2 + Conifer_ba_death_m2, tot_agb_m2_death = Decid_Broad_agb_death_m2 + Conifer_agb_death_m2)

tree.sum2 <- left_join(tree.sum, recruit)

tree.sum3 <- left_join(tree.sum2, death) 
tree.sum4 <- left_join(tree.sum3, ages, by = c("Year", "PLOT")) %>%
  mutate(age2 = Year - age)

glimpse(tree.sum4)
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# label shown in table = column stem in your data
vars <- c("DBH (cm)"                           = "DBH",
          "Density (stems ha⁻¹)"               = "Dens",
          "AGB (Mg ha⁻¹)"                      = "agb",
          "BA (m² ha⁻¹)"                       = "ba",
          "Deciduous BA (m² ha⁻¹)"             = "Decid_Broad_ba",
          "Recruitment (stems ha⁻¹)"           = "rec",
          "Deciduous recruitment (stems ha⁻¹)" = "Decid_Broad_rec",
          "Density of Death (stems ha⁻¹)" = "dens_death",
          "BA Death (m² ha⁻¹)" = "ba_death",
          "Deciduous death BA (m² ha⁻¹) " = "Decid_Broad_death")

tab <- sum2 |>
  rename(Dens = Density) |>
  # per m² → per ha (density, BA, recruitment); g/m² → Mg/ha (AGB)
  mutate(across(matches("^(sd_|min_|max_)?(Dens|ba|Decid_Broad_ba|rec|Decid_Broad_rec|ba_death|dens_death|Decid_Broad_death)$"), \(x) x * 1e4),
         across(matches("^(sd_|min_|max_)?agb$"), \(x) x / 100)) |>
  mutate(age_class = factor(age_class, levels = c("Young", "Intermediate", "Mature", "Old")) |>
           fct_na_value_to_level("Unassigned")) |>
  arrange(Network, age_class)

f  <- \(x) formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "fg", big.mark = ",")
pm <- \(d, v) str_c(f(d[[v]]), " ± ", f(d[[str_c("sd_", v)]]),
                    " (", f(d[[str_c("min_", v)]]), "–", f(d[[str_c("max_", v)]]), ")")

out <- tab |>
  select(Network, age_class, n) |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(map(vars, \(v) pm(tab, v))))

out |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Network") |>
  cols_label(age_class = "Age class", n = md("*n*")) |>
  cols_align("center", -age_class) |>
  tab_source_note("Values are mean ± SD (min–max).") |>
  tab_options(row_group.font.weight = "bold",
              column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
              table.font.size = px(12))

```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

# label shown in table = column stem in your data
vars <- c("DBH (cm)"                           = "DBH",
          "Density (stems ha⁻¹)"               = "Dens",
          "AGB (Mg ha⁻¹)"                      = "agb",
          "BA (m² ha⁻¹)"                       = "ba",
          "Deciduous BA (m² ha⁻¹)"             = "Decid_Broad_ba",
          "Recruitment (stems ha⁻¹)"           = "rec",
          "Deciduous recruitment (stems ha⁻¹)" = "Decid_Broad_rec",
          "Density of Death (stems ha⁻¹)" = "dens_death",
          "BA Death (m² ha⁻¹)" = "ba_death",
          "Deciduous death BA (m² ha⁻¹) " = "Decid_Broad_death")

tab2 <- sum3 |>
  rename(Dens = Density) |>
  # per m² → per ha (density, BA, recruitment); g/m² → Mg/ha (AGB)
  mutate(across(matches("^(sd_|min_|max_)?(Dens|ba|Decid_Broad_ba|rec|Decid_Broad_rec|ba_death|dens_death|Decid_Broad_death)$"), \(x) x * 1e4),
         across(matches("^(sd_|min_|max_)?agb$"), \(x) x / 100)) |>
  mutate(age_class = factor(age_class, levels = c("Young", "Intermediate", "Mature", "Old")) |>
           fct_na_value_to_level("Unassigned")) |>
  arrange(Network, age_class)

f  <- \(x) formatC(x, digits = 3, format = "fg", big.mark = ",")
pm <- \(d, v) str_c(f(d[[v]]), " ± ", f(d[[str_c("sd_", v)]]),
                    " (", f(d[[str_c("min_", v)]]), "–", f(d[[str_c("max_", v)]]), ")")

out2 <- tab2 |>
  select(Network, age_class, n) |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(map(vars, \(v) pm(tab2, v))))

out2 |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Network") |>
  cols_label(age_class = "Age class", n = md("*n*")) |>
  cols_align("center", -age_class) |>
  tab_source_note("Values are mean ± SD (min–max).") |>
  tab_options(row_group.font.weight = "bold",
              column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
              table.font.size = px(12))
```

```{r}
# Using tree sum.4 and looking at growht on the stand level...
glimpse(tree.sum4)

age.class.all <- ages %>%

  mutate(age2 = Year - age) %>%
    mutate(age_class = cut(age2,
                         breaks = c(0, 30, 60, 90,Inf),

                         include.lowest = TRUE))

demos <- tree.sum4 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) %>%
  #Calculate relative deciduous density, relative deciduous biomass, and deciduous index
  mutate(rel_dens_decid = Decid_Broad_dens/dens, 
         rel_biomass_decid = Decid_Broad_agb_m2/agb_m2, 
         decid.index.msq = (rel_dens_decid + rel_biomass_decid)/2) %>%
  #Categorize sites based on their deciduous index value!
  mutate(canopy= case_when(
    decid.index.msq > 0.66 ~ "decid",
    decid.index.msq < 0.33 ~ "spruce",
    TRUE ~ "mixed"
  )) %>%
  group_by(PLOT) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    interval      = Year - lag(Year),
    d_agb_m2      = agb_m2 - lag(agb_m2),     # change since previous census
    d_agb_m2_yr   = d_agb_m2 / interval,        # annualized (g m⁻² yr⁻¹)
    tot_agb_rec_yr = tot_agb_rec/interval,
    decid_agb_rec_yr = Decid_Broad_agb_m2_rec/interval, 
    con_agb_rec_yr = Conifer_agb_m2_rec/interval
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(!is.na(interval)) %>%
  filter(PLOT %!in% c("FP5C", "BDI5", "BDI6")) %>%
  left_join(age.class.all)
  
  
demo.death <- tree.sum4 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) replace_na(x, 0))) %>%
  group_by(PLOT) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    interval      = lead(Year) - Year,
    Year2 = lead(Year),
    tot_agb_death_yr = tot_agb_m2_death/interval,
    decid_agb_death_yr = Decid_Broad_agb_death_m2/interval, 
    con_agb_death_yr = Conifer_agb_death_m2/interval
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(!is.na(interval)) %>%
  filter(PLOT %!in% c("FP5C", "BDI5", "BDI6")) %>%
  select(c(PLOT, Year2, tot_agb_death_yr, decid_agb_death_yr, con_agb_death_yr)) %>%
  rename(Year = Year2)


demo.2 <- left_join(demos, demo.death)
glimpse(demo.2)


demo.3 <- demo.2 %>%
  select(c(Network, PLOT, sample.pd, tot_agb_death_yr, decid_agb_death_yr, con_agb_death_yr, age_class, age2, canopy, decid.index.msq, d_agb_m2_yr, tot_agb_rec_yr, decid_agb_rec_yr, con_agb_rec_yr)) %>%
  # fix growth
  mutate(d_agb_m2_yr2 = d_agb_m2_yr + tot_agb_death_yr - tot_agb_rec_yr)
  
demo.4 <- demo.3 %>%
  select(c(Network, PLOT, sample.pd, age_class, age2, canopy, decid.index.msq, d_agb_m2_yr, d_agb_m2_yr2, tot_agb_rec_yr,tot_agb_death_yr)) %>%

  mutate(demo_process = case_when(
```

# trying to look at the integral
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

net <- demo.4 %>%
  filter(demo_process == "Net", !is.na(anpp), !is.na(canopy))

# integrate over the age range all canopy types share (avoids extrapolating)
rng  <- net %>% group_by(canopy) %>% summarise(lo = min(age2), hi = max(age2))
ages <- seq(max(rng$lo), min(rng$hi), by = 1)

# fit loess to Net, predict on the age grid, cumulative trapezoid integral
fit_cum <- function(d, ages) {
  m <- loess(anpp ~ age2, data = d, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  tibble(age2 = ages, net = predict(m, tibble(age2 = ages))) %>%
    mutate(cum = cumsum(c(0, diff(age2) * (head(net, -1) + tail(net, -1)) / 2)))
}

# bootstrap by resampling plots
boot_cum <- function(d, ages, B = 500) {
  plots <- unique(d$PLOT)
  map_dfr(seq_len(B), \(b) {
    tibble(PLOT = sample(plots, replace = TRUE)) %>%
      inner_join(d, by = "PLOT", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      fit_cum(ages) %>%
      mutate(b = b)
  })
}

set.seed(1)
cum_boot <- net %>%
  group_by(canopy) %>%
  group_modify(\(d, k) boot_cum(d, ages)) %>%
  ungroup()

cum_sum <- cum_boot %>%
  group_by(canopy, age2) %>%
  summarise(est = median(cum),
            lo  = quantile(cum, 0.025),
            hi  = quantile(cum, 0.975), .groups = "drop")

auc <- cum_sum %>% filter(age2 == max(age2))   # total AUC over the shared range

ggplot(cum_sum, aes(age2, est, colour = canopy, fill = canopy)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(x = "Stand age (years)", y = expression(Cumulative~net~AGB~(g~m^-2)),
       colour = "Canopy", fill = "Canopy") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(auc, aes(canopy, est, colour = canopy)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = bquote(Net~AGB~accumulated~.(min(ages))*"–"*.(max(ages))~yr~(g~m^-2))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
fit_cum <- function(d, ages) {
  m <- loess(anpp ~ age2, data = d, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
  tibble(age2 = ages, rate = predict(m, tibble(age2 = ages))) %>%

}

library(mgcv)

procs <- demo.4 %>%
  filter(!is.na(anpp), !is.na(canopy)) %>%
  mutate(PLOT = factor(PLOT), canopy = factor(canopy))

rng  <- procs %>% group_by(canopy) %>% summarise(lo = min(age2), hi = max(age2))
ages <- seq(max(rng$lo), min(rng$hi), by = 1)

gam_cum <- function(d, ages, n_draws = 1000) {
  m  <- gam(anpp ~ canopy + s(age2, by = canopy, k = 5) + s(PLOT, bs = "re"),
            data = d, method = "REML")
  nd <- expand_grid(canopy = levels(d$canopy), age2 = ages) %>%
    mutate(canopy = factor(canopy, levels = levels(d$canopy)), PLOT = d$PLOT[1])
  X    <- predict(m, nd, type = "lpmatrix", exclude = "s(PLOT)")   # population-level curve
  beta <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_draws, coef(m), vcov(m, unconditional = TRUE))
  sims <- X %*% t(beta)                                             # rows = grid, cols = draws

  nd %>% select(canopy, age2) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(sims, .name_repair = \(x) str_c("d", seq_along(x)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("d"), names_to = "draw", values_to = "rate") %>%
    group_by(canopy, draw) %>%
    arrange(age2, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(cum = cumsum(c(0, diff(age2) * (head(rate, -1) + tail(rate, -1)) / 2))) %>%
    group_by(canopy, age2) %>%
    summarise(rate = mean(rate), est = mean(cum),
              lo = quantile(cum, 0.025), hi = quantile(cum, 0.975), .groups = "drop")
}

cum_proc <- procs %>%
  group_by(demo_process) %>%
  group_modify(\(d, k) gam_cum(d, ages)) %>%
  ungroup()

proc_col <- c(Growth = "#1b9e77", Recruit = "#7570b3", Death = "#d95f02")

comp <- cum_proc %>%
  filter(demo_process != "Net") %>%
  mutate(demo_process = factor(demo_process, levels = c("Recruit", "Growth", "Death")))
net_l <- cum_proc %>% filter(demo_process == "Net")
sum_l <- comp %>% group_by(canopy, age2) %>% summarise(est = sum(est), .groups = "drop")

p_budget <- ggplot() +
  geom_area(data = comp, aes(age2, est, fill = demo_process), alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_ribbon(data = net_l, aes(age2, ymin = lo, ymax = hi), fill = "black", alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(data = sum_l, aes(age2, est), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey20") +
  geom_line(data = net_l, aes(age2, est), linewidth = 1.4, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~canopy, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = proc_col) +
  labs(x = "Stand age (years)",
       y = expression(Cumulative~AGB~flux~(g~m^-2)),
       fill = NULL,
       caption = "Solid line ± 95% CI = Net; dashed = Growth + Recruit + Death") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
p_budget
```
